method: WebFetch httpx-style fetches; up to 3 attempts per site; wp-json probed where WP signals seen

sources.known_oddities: Posts include 'recent-news' alongside 'press-releases' category — filter on category slug to isolate press releases. Divi theme — listing markup is generic.
sources.notes: WP-JSON confirmed 200; default 'post' type; categorization filters press_release vs recent-news. Cleanest profile in batch.

sources.listing_selector: div.news-list article, ul.list li (semantic; verify in DOM)
sources.date_selector: span.date or sibling text node next to h4
sources.date_format_observed: Apr 30 (year inferred from context; check detail page for full date)
sources.known_oddities: Custom CMS (not WP). Pagination uses /P{n} suffix — unusual. Listing dates lack year; must dereference detail pages for canonical date.
sources.notes: RSS available — start there. HTML scrape as backup.

sources.known_oddities: Drupal site (image-styles signal). Try /jsonapi/node/news_press_release or /jsonapi/node/article for clean structured access. Includes time-of-day in dates — useful for ordering same-day items.
sources.notes: No WAF observed on this fetch. 1081 pages × 10 items ≈ 10,800 archive — high-volume. Consider /jsonapi probe before full HTML implementation.

sources.waf_evidence: 403 on root, /news/, /news, and /wp-json — likely Cloudflare or AWS WAF blocking non-browser UAs
sources.known_oddities: Every probe returned 403. Site is gated against scrapers from this fetch path.
sources.notes: needs_browser — retry with Playwright + realistic UA + cookie warm-up. Likely WP under hood (FL Gov sites historically WP) but blocked.

sources.known_oddities: Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) backend. Page loads with empty 'No results found' state — listings are populated by client-side JS calling an internal AEM search API. Need to capture XHR endpoint via real browser.
sources.notes: needs_browser. AEM JSON endpoints (/content/.../.model.json or /bin/...) likely exist; recon with Playwright + DevTools Network panel.

sources.known_oddities: AEM site. Press release sections appear empty in raw HTML — populated via client-side search. Newsroom nav points to /search-results.html?contentType=news&q= which is a JS-driven search UI.
sources.notes: needs_browser. Try GovDelivery or governor's office press email list as alternate path; site itself is poor scraping target.

sources.known_oddities: Drupal (drupalbase_uswds theme). RSS exists at /rss/news.xml — start there.
sources.notes: Clean Drupal site, RSS feed advertised. Recommend RSS-first with HTML detail-page enrichment.

sources.waf_evidence: 403 on /governor/news, /governor/press-releases. Root /governor 302-redirects to http (broken redirect chain). gov.colorado.gov ECONNREFUSED.
sources.known_oddities: Multiple broken paths. Colorado governor press lives at https://www.colorado.gov/governor (custom Squarespace-like setup) but every relevant subpath blocked from this fetcher.
sources.notes: needs_browser. Or use governor's @GovofCO Bluesky/Twitter as primary signal.

sources.known_oddities: mass.gov is known Akamai-fronted; aggressive WAF for non-browser UAs.
sources.notes: needs_browser — Playwright with stealth plugin, or pivot to GovDelivery email subscription for governor's press.

sources.known_oddities: Date format includes weekday — strip 'Weekday, ' prefix before parse. Drupal-style URL structure.
sources.notes: RSS advertised; HTML scrape clean. 9+ pages of archive accessible.

sources.known_oddities: Drupal. RSS feed advertised. 203 pages of archive depth — very large back-coverage opportunity.
sources.notes: Cleanest AG profile in batch. RSS-first, HTML backup.

sources.known_oddities: No summary on listing — only title + date. Detail-page fetch required for body. Drupal — try /jsonapi/node/press_release.
sources.notes: No WAF on this fetch despite NY state-WAF reputation. Listing is title-only — must follow each link for body.

sources.waf_evidence: 404 on /news/releases and /news. Likely IP-block or path moved.
sources.known_oddities: Both candidate paths returned 404 from this fetcher. Real path may be at /news/releases/2026 or similar; needs recon via search engine.
sources.notes: needs_browser or Google site:texasattorneygeneral.gov inurl:news to discover live path.

sources.known_oddities: Date format omits comma ('Apr 29 2026' not 'Apr 29, 2026') — non-standard parser handling. Drupal custom theme.
sources.notes: Note: original input listed /press-releases (404). Real path is /news/news-releases. RSS advertised.

sources.feed_wp_json: https://www.attorneygeneral.gov/wp-json/wp/v2/posts (returned [] empty on probe — categorization may exclude default 'posts'; try /wp-json/wp/v2/categories and filter)
sources.known_oddities: Note: original input was /press-releases/ (404). Real path is /taking-action/. Listing is a TABLE (uncommon) — not a card grid. wp-json default 'posts' returned empty array — items likely under custom post type or category-filtered. Try /wp-json/wp/v2/posts?categories={taking-action-id}.
sources.notes: WP confirmed via /page/{n}/ pagination idiom. HTML scrape works; WP-JSON needs custom-type discovery.

sources.known_oddities: CA Senate caucus runs uniform Drupal across all 40 SD-* subdomains. Profile here applies to sd1.senate.ca.gov through sd40.senate.ca.gov with parameter swap. Note: /news/press-release returned 404 — correct path is /press-releases (plural) at site-root. Some senators may use /news/press-release-list; recon each.
sources.notes: Highest-leverage profile in batch — clones cleanly to 40 senators. Drupal + per-page=10 + page query.

sources.waf_evidence: 403 on /press-releases and /newsroom — Drupal site with WAF rules against non-browser UAs
sources.known_oddities: nysenate.gov is Drupal with /jsonapi available historically; needs proper UA + Accept headers, possibly cookie warm-up.
sources.notes: needs_browser. Try /jsonapi/node/press_release with browser-fingerprint headers via Playwright.

sources.listing_selector: div items in main content (no semantic class — SharePoint default)
sources.detail_body_selector: main #ctl00_PlaceHolderMain or similar SharePoint content placeholder
sources.pagination_url_pattern: JS WebForm_DoPostBackWithOptions — no clean URL pagination; must POST __VIEWSTATE / __EVENTTARGET
sources.known_oddities: Classic SharePoint 2013/2016. Pagination requires preserving __VIEWSTATE and POSTing back with __EVENTTARGET=ctl00$...$pgrControl. Detail URLs are GUID-based query strings — ugly but stable.
sources.notes: First page scrape is trivial; deeper pagination needs SharePoint POSTback emulation. Acceptable to scrape page 1 daily, accept loss of historical depth, and run a one-time browser-driven backfill.

sources.known_oddities: WP confirmed (default 'post' type, full keyset present). Slider Revolution on homepage but listings/posts are static HTML. Detail URL path is /blog/ not /news/ — easy to miss.
sources.notes: Cleanest legislature profile. WP-JSON works, RSS works, HTML works. Per-caucus split — Republicans likely on a separate site (recon TBD).
